findings.rule_quote: Waiting period for pre-existing diseases disclosed by the persons to be insured, shall be maximum up to 36 months of continuous coverage under the Health Insurance policy.
findings.question_en: For how many continuous months has this policyholder been covered?
findings.action_en: Point out that the waiting period cannot exceed the cap; ask the insurer to reconsider.
